title: silicone steamer basket
text: silicone steamer basket. You can fit this into your pressure cooker or regular pot.  The sides stay up - so it doesn't fold up for storage.  It is an olivish green.  I like it.  Dishwasher safe.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Zavor Silicone Steamer Basket & Strainer for 6Qt & Larger Pressure Cookers, Multicookers, Instant & Stock Pots | BPA-free, Non-scratch Pressure Cooker Accessories Collection, Green (ZACMISB22)
features: PERFECT FIT - Fits any pot 8.27" wide and 4" high, making it compatible with most 6 qt and larger stovetop pressure cookers, electric pressure cookers, multi-cookers, and traditional cookware pieces. The pleated body also collapses for easy storage

SAFE - This steamer insert is BPA free, contains no plastic, and it's made of high-quality food-grade silicone that allows your food to stay free from harmful chemicals. Microwave safe, heat resistant, and oven safe up to 445°F (229°C)

PRACTICAL - Designed with high walls that keep the foods from falling out, the interlocking handles help with lifting after steaming, and the four silicone feet keep it from touching the cooking liquid, eliminating the need for an extra trivet

VERSATILE - Create healthy meals steaming vegetables 🥦, fish 🐟, dumplings 🥟, seafood 🦐 and more, including frozen foods ❄️. Silicone is non-scratch, allowing it to work along with any cookware material, even non-stick. It works as a strainer too

DURABLE & EASY - Dishwasher safe, naturally non-stick, flexible, rust and dent free, are all qualities of silicone that make cleaning, usage and storage a breeze. Forget about those high-maintenance metal accessories. Comes with Lifetime Warranty
